verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents the write path an agent needs: REST CRUD on module records, bulk upsert of up to 25,000 records, and an official MCP server that works with Claude, Cursor and similar tools for natural-language CRM operations. Field-level notifications on a Deal's Stage are also documented. However, nothing in the evidence shows the API or MCP server exposing email or meeting activity as signals for an agent to act on, so that part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented access to email/meeting data via API or MCP, an explicit example of updating deal stage or next-step fields, and independent hands-on corroboration.
